## Outcome

Describe the problem and the outcome of this change.

## Scope

Summarize the implementation and important tradeoffs. Link related issues or

## Verification

List the commands or review steps used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and repository-local instructions were followed.
- [ ] Tests and documentation were added or updated where needed.
- [ ] The owning repository or contract and compatibility effects are clear.
- [ ] Security and privacy effects were assessed and documented where needed.
- [ ] Public examples and fixtures are synthetic or clearly licensed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private source material, personal data, raw
      prompts, model files, generated indexes, or telemetry are included.
- [ ] Third-party material is attributed and license-compatible.
- [ ] Every commit carries a DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer.
- [ ] Security-sensitive details were reported privately, not in this pull
      request.
